examples.en: The wings are made of a polythene film stretched over a carbon fiber frame.
examples.zh: 机翼是由铺在碳纤维框架上的聚乙烯薄膜制成的。

examples.en: High-fiber diets are also linked to a reduced risk of heart disease and diabetes.
examples.zh: 高纤维饮食还能降低患心脏病和糖尿病的风险。

examples.en: Research now says adding fiber to the teen diet may help lower the risk of breast cancer.
examples.zh: 现在的研究表明，在青少年饮食中添加纤维可以帮助降低患乳腺癌的风险。
